title: CHAPTER XXX. The Queens Class Is Organized
chineseTitle: 第 30 章：奎恩备考班成立

paragraphs.en: Marilla laid down her knitting and leaned back in her chair. Her eyes felt tired, and she thought about getting new glasses soon since they had been causing her trouble lately.
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉放下手中的编织活，靠在椅子上。她的眼睛感到有些疲劳，想着最近视力不佳，打算不久后配副新眼镜。

paragraphs.en: It was nearly dark at Green Gables, where the November twilight had settled. The only light came from the stove's dancing red flames. Anne sat on the hearthrug, lost in a daydream.
paragraphs.zh: 绿山墙农舍已经暮色沉沉，十一月的黄昏已悄然降临。唯一的光线来自炉火跳跃的红焰。安妮坐在壁炉前的地毯上，沉浸在美好的遐想中。

paragraphs.en: She had been reading but now her book lay forgotten as she imagined grand castles and exciting adventures in the clouds.
paragraphs.zh: 她刚才在读书，但现在书被忘在一旁，脑海中浮现出云端中宏伟的城堡和激动人心的冒险。

paragraphs.en: Marilla watched Anne with a gentle tenderness that rarely showed. She loved Anne deeply, though not openly. Marilla feared being too indulgent and felt it sinful to love so intensely, which made her stricter than usual.
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉的目光中流露出一种温柔的关怀，这种神情并不常见。她深深地爱着安妮，但这份爱并未表露在外。玛丽拉担心自己过于纵容，觉得如此强烈的情感是一种罪过，因此比平时更加严格。

paragraphs.en: Anne sometimes thought Marilla was hard to please and lacked understanding. But she quickly dismissed such thoughts, remembering how much she owed Marilla.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮有时觉得玛丽拉要求太高，缺乏理解力。但她很快把这些想法抛在脑后，想起自己对玛丽拉的感激之情。

paragraphs.en: "Anne," said Marilla abruptly, "Miss Stacy visited today when you were with Diana."
paragraphs.zh: “安妮，”玛丽拉突然说道，“斯泰西小姐今天来拜访了你和戴安娜。”

paragraphs.en: Anne returned from her daydreams with a start and a sigh.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮从沉思中猛然回过神来，叹了口气。

paragraphs.en: Marilla, Diana and I had just returned from a visit to the Haunted Wood when we heard about Miss Stacy’s class. The girls in their teens were discussing the importance of forming good habits and setting proper ideals during their teenage years. Miss Stacy emphasized that by age twenty, our characters would be fully developed, making it crucial to establish a solid foundation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们刚从幽灵林回来，玛丽拉和戴安娜就听说了斯蒂西小姐的班级组织情况。十几岁的女孩们正在讨论在青少年时期养成良好习惯、树立正确理想的重要性。斯蒂西小姐强调，到二十岁的时候，我们的性格就会完全定型，因此在这个阶段打下坚实的基础至关重要。

paragraphs.en: Diana and I felt increasingly mature as we talked about our future. We decided to promise each other that we would remain single and live together forever, though Diana was still considering the idea of marrying a wild young man to reform him. We believed that by being sensible and forming respectable habits, we could ensure a well-developed character by twenty.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮和戴安娜在谈论未来时，感觉越来越成熟。我们决定相互承诺，永远保持单身并共同生活，尽管戴安娜还在考虑嫁给一个狂野的年轻人以改造他。我们相信，通过理智行事并养成良好的习惯，到二十岁的时候就能培养出一个品格高尚的人。

paragraphs.en: Miss Stacy’s visit today puzzled me; I wondered why she had come.
paragraphs.zh: 史蒂西小姐今天来访让我感到困惑，我不明白她为何而来。

paragraphs.en: Anne felt nervous when Marilla mentioned someone talking about her.
paragraphs.zh: 当玛丽拉提到有人在谈论她时，安妮感到有些紧张。

paragraphs.en: "About me?" Anne asked, flushing red. "Miss Stacy caught me reading 'Ben Hur' in class yesterday during dinner hour.
paragraphs.zh: “关于我？”安妮脸红了，问道，“斯泰西小姐昨天在晚餐时间抓到我在课堂上偷看《布登波洛克一家》了。”

paragraphs.en: Jane Andrews lent it to me. I was supposed to be studying Canadian history but couldn't resist the chariot race scene. Miss Stacy found out and took the book away without saying anything at first.
paragraphs.zh: 简·安德鲁斯把这本书借给了我。我本应研究加拿大历史，却忍不住看了那场战车赛场景。史蒂西小姐发现了这件事，起初没有说什么就把书收走了。

paragraphs.en: She kept me after recess, telling me I wasted study time and deceived her by pretending to read a history when it was actually fiction."
paragraphs.zh: 她课间结束后把我留下了，告诉我我浪费了学习时间，并且还欺骗了她，因为我假装在读历史书其实是在看小说。

paragraphs.en: Anne admitted feeling ashamed and begged for forgiveness, promising never to repeat such an act. Miss Stacy forgave her but didn't demand she avoid 'Ben Hur' entirely.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮承认自己感到羞愧，恳求原谅，并保证绝不再犯这样的错误。斯泰西小姐原谅了她，但并没有要求她完全避开《布登波洛克一家》这部作品。

paragraphs.en: Marilla dismissed Anne's guilt, saying she shouldn't bring storybooks to school and that she herself wasn't allowed novels as a child.
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉 dismissing 安妮的内疚，说她不应该把故事书带到学校，并且自己小时候也不被允许读小说。

paragraphs.en: Anne protested against calling Ben Hur a religious book, insisting that its excitement made it unsuitable for Sunday reading. She only read such books on weekdays with Miss Stacy or Mrs. Allan’s approval. Miss Stacy had once found her reading The Lurid Mystery of the Haunted Hall and forbidden her from continuing it.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮反对将《本·赫尔》称为宗教书籍，坚持认为这本书的精彩情节使其不适合在周日阅读。她只在斯泰西小姐或艾伦太太同意的情况下，在工作日里读这样的书。有一次，斯泰西小姐发现她在读《幽灵宅第的惊悚秘史》，并禁止她继续阅读。

paragraphs.en: Marilla lit the lamp and began working, noting Anne's eagerness to hear what Miss Stacy had to say. Anne apologized, promising not to speak further.
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉点燃了灯，开始工作，注意到安妮急于想知道斯泰西小姐要说些什么。安妮道歉，并承诺不再多言。

paragraphs.en: Miss Stacy wanted to organize a class for advanced students preparing for Queen’s entrance examination. She planned extra lessons after school. She asked Marilla if Anne could join.
paragraphs.zh: 斯泰西小姐想为准备参加女王学院入学考试的高级学生组织一个班级。她计划在放学后增加额外的课程。她询问玛丽拉，是否可以让安妮加入。

paragraphs.en: Marilla inquired about Anne’s thoughts on the idea of attending Queen's and becoming a teacher.
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉询问安妮对于就读女王学院并成为一名教师的想法。

paragraphs.en: Anne knelt straight and clasped her hands, exclaiming, "Oh, Marilla! It has been my dream for the past six months since Ruby and Jane started talking about studying for the Entrance. But I never mentioned it because I thought it would be useless."
paragraphs.zh: 安妮笔直地跪下，双手合十，脱口而出：“哦，玛丽拉！自从鲁比和简开始谈论入学考试的事情以来，这是我过去六个月的梦想。但我从未提起过，因为我觉得这毫无用处。”

paragraphs.en: Marilla replied, "Don't worry about that. Matthew and I promised to give you the best education possible when we brought you up. We believe a girl should be prepared to earn her own living.
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉回答说：“别担心那个。马修和我当初把你带回家的时候就承诺要给你最好的教育。我们认为女孩子应该做好准备，靠自己的能力谋生。”

paragraphs.en: You'll always have a home at Green Gables as long as we are here, but it's wise to be ready for anything."
paragraphs.zh: 只要你我们在这里，绿山墙农庄永远都是你的家，但未雨绸缪总是明智的。

paragraphs.en: Anne hugged Marilla tightly, saying, "Thank you so much, Marilla and Matthew. I will study hard and do my best to make you proud. Don't expect too much in geometry, but I think I can handle other subjects if I work hard."
paragraphs.zh: 安妮紧紧拥抱了玛丽拉，说道：“谢谢你们，玛丽拉和马修。我会努力学习，尽我最大的努力让你们感到骄傲。几何可能会有点难，但我相信只要努力，其他科目我还是能应付过去的。”

paragraphs.en: Marilla added, "You'll probably manage well enough. Miss Stacy says you are bright and diligent." She didn’t mention that Miss Stacy had also said Anne was vain; she wanted to avoid encouraging her.
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉补充道：“你大概能应付得不错。斯泰西小姐说你聪明勤奋。”她没有提到斯泰西小姐还说过安妮爱慕虚荣；她不想因此而鼓励安妮。

paragraphs.en: Anne continued blissfully, "Now I will take more interest in my studies because I have a purpose in life. Mr. Allan says everyone should have a purpose and pursue it faithfully. He advises we must first ensure the purpose is worthy.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮继续幸福地说道：“现在我会更加关注我的学习，因为我有了人生的目标。阿兰先生说每个人都应该有目标，并且要忠实地追求它。他建议我们首先要确保这个目标是值得的。”

paragraphs.en: Wanting to be a teacher like Miss Stacy would be a noble profession, wouldn't you agree, Marilla?"
paragraphs.zh: “你想成为一名像斯泰西小姐那样的老师，这难道不是一份崇高的职业吗，玛丽拉？”

paragraphs.en: Anne was devastated when Diana Barry did not join the Queen's class. Since Minnie May’s illness, Anne and Diana had always been together. On the first evening of extra lessons, Anne watched Diana walk home alone through Birch Path and Violet Vale.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮得知戴安娜·巴里没有加入女王班时，心情非常沮丧。自从米妮·梅生病后，安妮和戴安娜一直形影不离。在补习课的第一晚，安妮看着戴安娜独自一人从白橡树小径和紫罗兰谷走回家。

paragraphs.en: The sight nearly broke her resolve; she managed to stay seated but felt a lump in her throat. To hide her tears, she quickly turned to her Latin grammar book. Anne would have done anything to prevent Gilbert Blythe or Josie Pye from seeing her cry.
paragraphs.zh: 这景象几乎让她改变了主意，她勉强坐了下来，却感到喉咙哽咽。为了掩饰泪水，她迅速翻开了手中的拉丁文语法书。安妮恨不得能做些什么来阻止吉尔伯特·布雷思或乔西·派伊看见她哭泣。

paragraphs.en: That night, Anne lamented to Marilla about Diana leaving alone for the Entrance class. "I wished Diana could have studied with us too," she sighed. "But perfection isn't always possible."
paragraphs.zh: 那天晚上，安妮向玛丽拉倾诉起戴安娜独自去参加入学考试班的事。“我希望戴安娜也能和我们在一起学习就好了，”她叹了口气，“但完美总是难以实现的。”

paragraphs.en: Mrs. Lynde often spoke harshly but truthfully. Anne believed the Queen's class would be fascinating. Jane and Ruby aspired to become teachers; Ruby planned to teach for two years before marriage, while Jane vowed a lifetime of teaching.
paragraphs.zh: 雷切尔·林德夫人虽然言语尖刻，却直言不讳。安妮相信女王班将会非常有趣。简和露比都渴望成为一名教师；露比计划在结婚前教书两年，而简则发誓要终身从教。

paragraphs.en: Josie Pye studied out of necessity, not wanting to work. Mrs. Lynde suggested her father was miserly. Moody Spurgeon aimed to be a minister, despite his comical appearance.
paragraphs.zh: 乔西·派伊出于无奈才勉强读书，她并不想干活。雷切尔·林德太太暗示她的父亲小气得很。情绪多变的斯普尔根虽然相貌滑稽，却立志成为一名牧师。

paragraphs.en: Anne found this amusing but hoped he would mature intellectually.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮觉得这挺有趣，但希望他能早日在智力上有所成熟。

paragraphs.en: Charlie Sloane dreamed of politics and Parliament, though Mrs. Lynde doubted his success due to the Sloanes' honesty in an era favoring rascals. Anne wondered about Gilbert Blythe's future, knowing little of his ambitions.
paragraphs.zh: 查理·斯洛恩梦想着从政和议会，尽管雷切尔·林德太太怀疑他因斯洛恩家族诚实的名声而在一个青睐恶棍的时代难以成功。安妮则在思考吉尔伯特·布莱思的未来，对她所了解的他的抱负知之甚少。

paragraphs.en: Gilbert and Anne now openly competed for the top spot in class. Previously, Gilbert's determination to excel matched Anne’s, but their rivalry had intensified. Other classmates acknowledged their superiority without attempting to compete.
paragraphs.zh: 吉尔伯特和安妮现在公开争夺班级的第一名。此前，吉尔伯特力求卓越的决心与安妮不相上下，但他们的竞争却日益激烈。其他同学虽然承认她们的优越地位，却没有试图与其一较高下。

paragraphs.en: Since refusing his plea by the pond, Gilbert ignored Anne entirely. He interacted with other girls, shared books and puzzles, discussed lessons, and walked home from prayer meetings or Debating Club with them. However, he paid no attention to Anne, making her feel neglected.
paragraphs.zh: 自pond边拒绝了他的请求后，吉尔伯特完全忽略了安妮。他与其他女孩交往，分享书籍和谜题，讨论功课，并且在祈祷会或辩论俱乐部结束后与她们一起步行回家。然而，他对安妮毫不在意，这让安妮感到被冷落了。

paragraphs.en: Anne tried to convince herself she didn't care, but deep down, she knew differently. She regretted not answering him differently at the Lake of Shining Waters. Suddenly, her resentment vanished just when she needed it most.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮试图说服自己并不在意，但内心深处她知道自己并非如此。她后悔在银湖没有给他一个不同的答复。就在她最需要释然的时候，她的怨气突然烟消云散了。

paragraphs.en: She realized she had unknowingly forgiven and forgotten him.
paragraphs.zh: 她意识到自己不知不觉间已经原谅并忘了他。

paragraphs.en: She vowed to bury these feelings deeply. Gilbert might have been more sensitive than he appeared; however, Anne ensured he believed she didn't feel his scorn. The only comfort was that she harshly snubbed Charlie Sloane consistently.
paragraphs.zh: 她发誓要把这些感觉深深地埋藏起来。吉尔伯特可能比表面上看起来更敏感；然而，安妮确保他相信自己并不在意他的轻视。唯一让她感到安慰的是，她一直冷落查理·斯洛恩，毫不留情。

paragraphs.en: The winter at Green Gables was filled with pleasant duties and studies. Anne found each day as fulfilling as golden beads on a necklace. She eagerly learned lessons and sought honors, read delightful books, practiced new pieces for the Sunday-school choir, and enjoyed Saturday afternoons at the manse with Mrs. Allan.
paragraphs.zh: 绿山墙农庄的冬天充满了愉快的责任和学习。安妮觉得每一天都像项链上的金珠一样充实。她热切地学习功课，争取荣誉，阅读精彩的小说，练习周日学校合唱团的新曲目，并在艾伦太太家享受星期六下午的美好时光。

paragraphs.en: Spring arrived before she realized it, bringing blooms to all.
paragraphs.zh: 她几乎都没察觉，春天悄然而至，万物复苏。

paragraphs.en: However, by spring, studies began to lose their charm. The Queen's class, left behind while others ventured into nature, longed from their windows. Latin verbs and French exercises seemed less engaging than they had in winter.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，到了春天，学习的乐趣开始减退。女王班的学生们被留在室内，而其他同学则外出探索自然，他们透过窗户羡慕不已。冬天那些生动有趣的拉丁语和法语练习，现在似乎不再那么吸引人了。

paragraphs.en: Anne and Gilbert also grew indifferent. Both teacher and students were glad when the term ended and vacation days stretched before them.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮和吉尔伯特也变得不那么在意了。老师和学生们都高兴地迎来了假期，期待着漫长的休假时光。

paragraphs.en: Miss Stacy commended their work, encouraging them to enjoy outdoor activities and build health, vitality, and ambition for next year's challenges. She would return, having decided against another school due to her growing interest in her pupils at Avonlea.
paragraphs.zh: 斯泰西小姐称赞了她们的学习成果，鼓励大家多参与户外活动，增强体质和活力，并为埃文利明年的挑战树立雄心。她决定不继续执教另一所学校，因为对她在这儿的学生越来越感兴趣。

paragraphs.en: Moody Spurgeon, moved by the news, celebrated loudly, blushing every time he thought about it for a week.
paragraphs.zh: 莫蒂·斯普劳仁听到这个消息后兴奋不已，一想到这事就满脸通红地大声庆祝了一个星期。

paragraphs.en: Anne beamed with joy, saying, "Dear Stacy, it would be terrible if you didn't return. I couldn’t bear to continue my studies without you."
paragraphs.zh: 安妮欣喜若狂地说：“斯蒂西，你可别不来啊。没有你在身边，我真不知道该怎么继续我的学习。”

paragraphs.en: That evening, Anne packed her textbooks into an old trunk in the attic, locked it, and tossed the key into a blanket box.
paragraphs.zh: 那天晚上，安妮把教科书装进阁楼里一个旧木箱子里，上了锁，然后把钥匙扔进了毛毯盒里。

paragraphs.en: "I won't even touch a schoolbook during vacation," she told Marilla. "I've studied as hard as possible this term and memorized every geometry proposition by heart. I just feel tired of sensible things and want to let my imagination run wild for the summer."
paragraphs.zh: “假期里我连课本都不碰，”她对玛丽拉说，“这学期我已经尽力学习了，每个几何命题都背得滚瓜烂熟。现在我觉得理智的事情太累了，只想在夏天让自己的想象力尽情驰骋。”

paragraphs.en: Mrs. Lynde mentioned that Anne would need longer skirts next year, saying she was growing legs and eyes. Anne decided to believe in fairies fully during her summer vacation.
paragraphs.zh: 雷切尔·林德夫人提到，安妮下一年需要更长的裙子，说她正在长腿和眼睛。安妮决定在暑假期间彻底相信精灵的存在。

paragraphs.en: Anne anticipated a fun-filled holiday with various activities: Ruby Gillis's birthday party, Sunday school picnic, missionary concert, and dinner at the White Sands Hotel with Mr. Barry.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮期待着一个充满乐趣的假期，有各种活动等着她：鲁比·吉利斯的生日派对、星期日学校野餐、传教士音乐会以及与巴里先生在白沙滩酒店共进晚餐。

paragraphs.en: The next afternoon, Mrs. Lynde came over to find out why Marilla hadn't attended the Aid meeting on Thursday. People knew something was amiss when Marilla wasn't there.
paragraphs.zh: 第二天下午，雷切尔·林德太太过来询问为什么玛丽拉没有参加周四的募捐会议。大家都知道，当玛丽拉没到场时，肯定出了什么问题。

paragraphs.en: Marilla explained that Matthew had a heart issue on Thursday but was better now. The doctor advised him to avoid excitement and heavy work, which Marilla found challenging since Matthew rarely sought out excitement.
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉解释说，马修在星期四遇到了心脏方面的问题，但现在好些了。医生建议他避免激动和重活，这让玛丽拉觉得有些为难，因为马修平时很少主动寻求刺激。

paragraphs.en: Mrs. Rachel agreed to stay for tea when Marilla invited her, despite not wanting to leave immediately.
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉邀请雷切尔·林德喝下午茶，尽管她不想马上离开，但雷切尔还是答应留下了。

paragraphs.en: In the parlor, Anne prepared tea and baked light biscuits that pleased even Mrs. Rachel's critical taste.
paragraphs.zh: 在客厅里，安妮准备了茶，并烤制了一些轻盈的饼干，连挑剔的雷切尔太太也觉得十分可口。

paragraphs.en: Marilla praised Anne, saying she had become a real asset and was now reliable. She noted how Anne had overcome her earlier flighty tendencies.
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉称赞安妮，说她现在已经成了一个真正的资产，并且变得可靠多了。她提到安妮克服了之前那种容易分心的毛病。

paragraphs.en: Mrs. Rachel reflected on her first encounter with Anne three years ago. "I never thought she'd turn out so well," she said. "Remember that tantrum?
paragraphs.zh: 雷切尔太太回想起三年前第一次遇到安妮的情景，“我从没想过她会变得这么出色，”她说，“你还记得那次发脾气吗？

paragraphs.en: I told Thomas at home that night Marilla Cuthbert would regret her decision." Mrs. Rachel admitted to making a mistake but was glad she had corrected it.
paragraphs.zh: 我告诉汤玛斯，那天晚上在家说玛丽拉·库伯特会后悔她的决定。“雷切尔夫人承认自己犯了一个错误，但很高兴及时纠正了。”

paragraphs.en: Anne had improved significantly over the past three years, especially in appearance. She was now a pretty girl, though Mrs. Rachel preferred Diana Barry or Ruby Gillis with their more vibrant looks. However, when Anne was around, even Diana and Ruby seemed less striking.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮在过去三年里进步显著，尤其是在外貌上。她现在已经是个挺不错的女孩了，不过雷切尔太太更喜欢戴安娜·巴里或 ruby 吉利斯那种更有活力的样子。然而，在安妮身边时，戴安娜和 ruby 却似乎也不那么引人注目了。

paragraphs.en: "It's like white June lilies next to big red peonies," Mrs. Rachel mused.
paragraphs.zh: “就像白百合衬着大红牡丹一样，”雷切尔太太沉思道。
